rows.label: Energy Lab: Dera, Spectra, Cyanex, then Komorex

conditions: Ghost (x1) tier Komorex research costs 10,000 credits, 60 Fieldron Sample, 850 Polymer Bundle, 1,300 Alloy Plate and 10 Gallium; Cyanex before it costs 7,500 credits, 30 Fieldron Sample, 300 Plastids, 2,250 Salvage and 10 Control Module.
In an established clan this is already done and costs you nothing.

rows.label: Fieldron
rows.alt: or craft from Fieldron Samples, 12h each

conditions: The Invasion payout lands only when the Invasion itself completes.
bonuses: Rare and Reinforced Corpus storage containers and Orb Vallis tier-4 bounties also pay Fieldron.

disclosures.title: crafting Fieldron from scratch
disclosures.body: Each Fieldron is its own Energy Lab blueprint (15,000 credits) plus 15,000 credits, 10 Fieldron Sample, 1 Control Module, 500 Salvage and 250 Plastids, 12h. Fieldron Samples drop in Corpus territory; the Dark Sector Survivals Wahiba (Mars) and Kelashin (Neptune) are the named spots.

bonuses: Distilling Extractors on Jupiter add passive Hexenon.

disclosures.title: using it
disclosures.body: Semi-Rifle Cannonade removes the 3.5x zoom's fire-rate penalty; keep it unranked, since its punch-through moves the explosion to the last surface hit. With Continuous Manual Trigger the 3.5x mode fires once and stops until you unscope, so tap-fire. The explosion staggers you up close and can't headshot.
